learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire in-depth knowledge of mathematical topics relevant to applications in computer science, specifically artificial intelligence and cyber security, or necessary for a deeper understanding of fundamental mathematical concepts. The focus is also on mathematical thinking, working, and modeling methods.

Students are able to recognize, model, and solve mathematical problems from computer science, especially artificial intelligence and cyber security. They can use a computer algebra system for mathematical modeling and calculations. The associated algorithmic methods of mathematics are exemplified. Students are able to successfully complete advanced courses involving mathematical modeling.
The main focus is on subject-specific and methodological competence in the topics covered.
The acquisition of social skills is not the primary focus of this module but is promoted through student cooperation and collaborative problem-solving.

Personal competence is fostered through in-depth independent work and solving complex problems. Through the application of mathematical solution techniques and their critical understanding, students develop the ability for abstract and analytical thinking.

syllabus_topics: Quadrics as solution sets of quadratic equations
Cyclotomic polynomials and fundamental theorem of algebra
Solution methods for linear differential equations
teaching_methods: Lectures with direct use of a computer algebra system
Problem-solving using a computer algebra system
Discussion of solutions in iLearn system
assessment_rules: The examination is a 90-minute written paper. The weighting of the grade for the overall degree is 5/210.
